component.name: CWTNote
component.summary: Local-first Markdown notes with automatic Git history

description.p: CWTNote is a local-first Markdown note application for the Linux desktop that keeps every note in a plain-text vault.
Notes are stored as plain Markdown files in a vault, and every save is recorded in a local Git repository.

ul.li: Automatic local Git commits and per-note history
Quick note window for fast capture

screenshot.caption: Markdown editor with the note vault sidebar
Quick note window for fast capture

description.p: This release renames the application ID to io.github.Traliran.CWTNote and adds Flatpak packaging.

ul.li: New application ID and matching desktop, icon, and metainfo files.
Flatpak manifest with a bundled Git runtime.
